scenes.text: Which tool measures the length of a pencil fairly? Let us think carefully. Standard units are agreed and repeatable for everyone. The answer is a ruler. Great work!
Where should a centimetre measurement begin? Let us think carefully. Standard units are agreed and repeatable for everyone. The answer is the zero mark. Great work!
What does a standard unit have for everyone? Let us think carefully. Standard units are agreed and repeatable for everyone. The answer is same agreed size. Great work!
Why may two children get different handspan counts? Let us think carefully. Standard units are agreed and repeatable for everyone. The answer is different hand sizes. Great work!
